extension.description: You can add any custom metadata here when you extend cw721-base

token_uri.description:
Universal resource identifier for this NFT
Should point to a JSON file that conforms to the ERC721
Metadata JSON Schema

calendar_d.description:
Calendar this event belongs to. Token ID of the parent calendar NFT,
or `None` for standalone events (no parent calendar).

cid.description: IPFS CID pointing to the full Nostr event JSON (off-chain only).

d_tag.description:
Cached d-tag for addressable events (kind 30000–39999).
Avoids decoding `e` just to read the identifier.

kind.description:
Nostr event kind (31922 date-based, 31923 time-based).
Always populated for efficient on-chain filtering.

nostr_e_d.description: Optional: Store the raw nostr event ID for verification.

on_chain.description:
`true` = full Nostr event stored on-chain in `e`.
`false` = only an IPFS CID pointer lives on-chain.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
